It is essential to maintain a comprehensive list of all products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this information with your doctor and pharmacist. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. Otherwise, contact a poison control center without delay. In the United States, you can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. Laboratory tests, such as measurements of sodium and potassium levels, may be conducted before or after taking this medication. Ensure that you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you are unable to consume the entire solution and water as directed, contact your doctor immediately. Store the unmixed container at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in May 2024. Important Usage Information: This document provides a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. How to Use: Read the Medication Guide and Instructions for Use provided by your pharmacist before starting this medication and each time you receive a refill. Follow any special dietary instructions given by your doctor. Typically, you may have a light breakfast or only clear liquids the day before your procedure. After breakfast, consume only clear liquids until after your procedure. Avoid milk, alcoholic beverages, and any food or drink that is red or purple in color. Do not take any other oral medications within one hour of starting to drink the mixture. Use this product as directed by your doctor, usually in two doses: one in the evening before the colonoscopy and the second dose the following morning. Before use, pour the contents into the mixing container as instructed by the manufacturer. Add cool water, mix thoroughly, and drink the entire mixture. After consuming the mixture, drink two additional containers of water over the next hour. Watery bowel movements typically begin approximately one hour after drinking the mixed liquid. Side Effects: This medication is expected to cause very watery bowel movements. Other possible side effects include nausea, vomiting, bloating, or stomach/abdominal cramping. Remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. However, this medication can lead to excessive loss of fluids and salts, resulting in dehydration or electrolyte imbalances. Severe allergic reactions to this drug are rare. This is not a complete list of possible side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. Precautions: Before taking this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you have any allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and exhibits severe symptoms such as passing out or trouble breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Storage: Store the unmixed container at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed.
